current_bottleneck: 318a showed that explicit daily full covariance can widen and slightly improve dependence, but the decoder state was incomplete: it conditioned on previous transitions and history context, not the current generated level. That omission makes mean reversion and level anchoring nearly impossible during ancestral sampling.
last_result_summary: 318a-v0 trained stably but overfit early, best epoch 3, and scored 2/11, passing only block_ar and cointegration. It produced very wide paths: coverage90 0.993, calibration error 0.340, surface failed, daily KS 5/25, level KS 0/25, corr ratio 0.257, rank ratio 3.670, MR ratio -0.058 with 0/24 active cells. The chain-rule full-covariance paradigm is not falsified, but the state representation needs current-level feedback.
next_step_recommendation: Run 318b-v0 as the minimal repair: same chain-rule daily full-covariance likelihood, but feed the current logit level as part of the recurrent decoder state during teacher forcing and ancestral sampling. This is required by the probability chain rule and should be tested before retiring 318.
